programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are excited to play with their new friend Roarian, the Flying Lion! But when Roarian loses his magical sunstone, he turns into a statue! Now it's up to Blaze and AJ to find the sunstone and restore Roarian's powers!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blackbelt isn't the only Ninja Master in his family- his Grandma Ninja has awesome moves too! But when she gets a nasty cold, Blaze, AJ and Blackbelt set out to make the most powerful medicine there is: Ninja Soup!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: A visit to the King's castle goes awry when the King accidentally catapults himself far, far away! To bring him home, Blaze, AJ and the King's adorable pet dragon Zeek must transform into knights in shining armor!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are driving through the desert when they meet a magical Genie who loves to grant wishes! But when the Genie loses the jewels that give him his powers, Blaze and AJ go on a quest to get them back!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Great Egg Hunt has just begun, and Blaze and Crusher are racing all over town to see who can find the most eggs. Only the first truck to collect 100 eggs will win the egg-ceptionally tasty chocolate trophy!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: It may be nighttime in Axle City, but all the trucks are staying up super late for the ultimate all-night race: the Midnight Mile! And the first truck to cross the finish line will win the Glow-in-the-Dark trophy!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are racing through the jungle when Blaze gets trapped in super sticky mud! Now it’s up to AJ and his new animal friends to go on an epic adventure to save Blaze!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Championship Race is about to start, and all the fastest trucks in town are ready to roll! But when Crusher steals the trophy before the race even begins, it’s up to Blaze and his friends to get it back in time.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Somewhere, on The Island of Lost Treasure, there are incredible riches just waiting to be discovered. And Blaze and Darington are determined to be the first to find them!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are helping their friend Stripes look after some baby animals, when the little critters accidentally float away on big bubbles. Now, it’s up to these three babysitters to find their adorable animal friends and save the day!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Pickle is putting on a magic show for all of Axle City! But when Crusher accidentally makes a magical mistake, it’s up to Blaze and Pickle to fix the magic and save their friends! Abra-ka-Pickle!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Axle City toy store has an amazing machine that can make any toy you want! But when Crusher uses it, he makes giant toys that run amok! Only Blaze and Watts can stop the giant toys from making a giant mess!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Gasquatch invites Blaze and AJ to his ice cream party! But he forgot something important – the ice cream! So, Blaze transforms into an Ice Cream Truck and races to reach Gasquatch’s house in time!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: It’s time for the Gold Medal Games, and Blaze is ready to compete! But when Crusher cheats and sends his rival flying far away, Blaze has to speed back to Axle City to beat the buzzer and win that medal!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ take off into space for a race that’s out of this world! Along the way to Planet Victory, they meet friendly aliens, dodge asteroids, and face off against Crusher’s space ship!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: For the first time ever, Blaze and AJ are racing under the ocean! Blaze transforms into a submarine and speeds through sunken ships and coral reefs to reach the giant sand castle at the finish line!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: When Axle City is visited by a littering raccoon, it’s up to Blaze to save the day as a Super Recycling Truck! He cleans up the town and rescues his friends – just in time for a final showdown with the Litter Critter!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze stops into Gabby’s Garage for a quick repair – just as she gets an alert! Three far-flung trucks need her mechanical know-how! So, Blaze and AJ volunteer to help her take her garage on the go!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: All of Axle City is enjoying the Balloon Fair – until Crusher and Pickle get stuck on a runaway hot-air balloon! Now it’s up to Blaze and AJ to rescue their high-flying friends… before they crash into the Slime Volcano!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are babysitting for Baby Gherkin! When it’s time for her nap, they tell her three epic bedtime stories about police, cowboys, and superheroes – all starring Blaze and his friends!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: When a windstorm blows away the supplies for Stripes’ Animal Party, Blaze transforms into the one Monster Machine strong enough to haul it all back – a Big Rig! There’s nothing he can’t pull with that Big Rig Force!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ make friends with a space alien named Gormy! But when Gormy’s jetpack loses power, they set out to help him find six special space batteries so he can fly home to his alien family!

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are spending the day with some very special trucks: Blaze’s family! His Mom, Dad, and little sister Sparkle join Blaze in a race against Crusher to prove they’re the world’s fastest family!

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: South Park: Comment manger avec son cul
programme.desc: Cartman placarde la photo de Kenny associée à la mention 'Enfant disparu' sur tous les packs de lait du pays.

programme.title: South Park: L'Engin
programme.desc: Mr Garrison, ne supportant plus que ses vols d'avions soient annulés ou retardés, décide d'inventer un nouveau moyen de transport.Kyle est très embarrassé quand il reçoit la visite de son cousin de New-York, également prénommé Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Les riches debarquent
programme.desc: Se sentant rejeté, Token décide d'appeler d'autres riches. Mais les hommes de la ville ne supportent pas l'arrivée de ces riches.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny Se Meurt
programme.desc: Cartman tente de sauver la vie de Kenny en suppliant le Congrès de faire reprendre la recherche sur les cellules souches.

programme.title: South Park: L'Episode de Butters
programme.desc: Butters fait quelques découvertes qui vont changer le cours de son existence. Son père est bisexuel et sa mère tente de le tuer. Heureusement tout s'arrange à la fin.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Maury Povich Show reçoit des personnes difformes et leur offre des cadeaux. Les gamins décident d'envoyer Butters au show avec des testicules en latex attachées au menton.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Vacances à Aspen. Les gamins ont des ennuis avec des ados fous de ski et les parents vont vivre l'enfer de l'arnaque.

programme.title: South Park: La bande-annonce du nouveau Terrance et Phillip
programme.desc: Le visionnage d'une bande annonce se transforme en course contre la montre pour trouver une télé valable.
programme.sub-title: La bande-annonce du nouveau Terrance et Phillip

programme.title: South Park: Le veau, c'est rigolo
programme.desc: Les enfants se soucient du sort des veaux qui sont en réalité des bébé vaches torturés.

programme.title: South Park: Professeur Chaos
programme.desc: Butters est exclu du groupe des gamins. Excedé, il s'invente un alter-égo maléfique, le Professeur Chaos. Pendant ce temps, Stan, Cartman et Kyle mettent en place une sélection pour trouver un remplaçant à Kenny.

programme.title: South Park: Les cathos, c'est chaud
programme.desc: Le père Maxi propose aux enfants de partir pour une croisière en compagnie de prêtres et d'évêques venus de tous les pays. Mais Randy raconte qu'il a entendu aux informations que les prêtres faisaient subir des mauvais traitements aux enfants.

programme.title: South Park: Bérets Gratos
programme.desc: Les gamins en ont marre que les scénaristes retouchent leurs films avec des images de synthèse ou en éditant les images ou les mots choquants.

programme.title: South Park: Les seins de Bebe mettent en danger la société
programme.desc: La puberté fait irruption à South Park: Barbara a des seins qui poussent et les garçons ont un comportement des plus bizarres.
programme.sub-title: Les seins de Bebe mettent en danger la société

programme.title: South Park: Les enlèvements d'enfants, c'est pas marrant
programme.desc: Les parents sont victimes de la psychose de l'enlèvement. Au fil des infos, ils apprennent que leurs enfants peuvent être enlevés par eux-mêmes.
programme.sub-title: Les enlèvements d'enfants, c'est pas marrant

programme.title: South Park: Une échelle pour aller au ciel
programme.desc: Pour profiter d'une razzia de bonbons, les gamins sont contraints de retrouver Kenny au ciel pour récuperer un ticket de la plus haute importance.
programme.sub-title: Une échelle pour aller au ciel

programme.title: South Park: Le retour de la communauté de l'anneau des deux tours
programme.desc: Une nuit de folie, où les gamins passionnés par Le Seigneur des anneaux vont entretenir un quiproquo terrible à propos d'un film pornographique substitué à une copie du Seigneur.
programme.sub-title: Le retour de la communauté de l'anneau des deux tours

programme.title: South Park: Le camp de la mort de tolérance
programme.desc: Les parents veulent sauver leurs enfants de la spirale de l'intolérance. En même temps Mr Garrison en fait peut-être trop. Et une pauvre gerbille vit un road movie passionnant dans les entrailles de Mr Esclave.
programme.sub-title: Le camp de la mort de tolérance

programme.title: South Park: Le Plus Gros Connard de l'Univers
programme.desc: Chef et Mme Cartman décident de purger Eric de l'âme de Kenny. Pendant ce temps Stan tente de prouver que John Edward est un imposteur. Les voies de la solution s'avèreront d'ordre stellaire.
programme.sub-title: Le Plus Gros Connard de l'Univers

programme.title: South Park: Mon Futur Moi et Moi
programme.desc: Un homme se présentant comme le Stan Marsh du futur arrive à South Park. Le Stan du passé est littéralement effaré de voir qu'il tombera dans une telle déchéance.

programme.title: South Park: La Chute du traîneau rouge
programme.desc: Cartman est très tendu. Il a commis trop de mauvaises actions pour espérer avoir des cadeaux à ce Noël. Il tente alors de se racheter en convaincant le Père Noël d'apporter Noël en Irak.

programme.title: South Park: I'm a Little Bit Country
programme.desc: La sonde anale de Cartman est réactivée. Les garçons se retrouvent dans l'espace et ils ont une mission très, très importante: Sauver la terre!

programme.title: South Park: Les gangs de Denver
programme.desc: Timmy aide Jimmy à former un club composé d'autres enfants handicapés de naissance. Ils sont heureux de découvrir qu'un groupe de ce genre existe déjà.

programme.title: South Park: Papier toilette
programme.desc: Cartman veut faire une crasse à son prof, qui vient de le punir. Pour se venger, il demande aux garçons de se joindre à lui pour remplir la maison du prof de papier toilette.

programme.title: South Park: Gros Cul et Tête de Nœud
programme.desc: Kyle vient de réaliser un brillant exposé sur la culture hispano-américaine. C'est désormais au tour de Cartman de se lancer dans un discours sur les artistes hispano-américains.
programme.sub-title: Gros Cul et Tête de Nœud

programme.title: South Park: Les petits policiers
programme.desc: Les enfants décident de jouer les détectives privés. Leur première affaire consiste à retrouver une tarte à la cerise.

programme.title: South Park: La Cupidité de L'Homme Rouge
programme.desc: Monsieur Broslofsky perd tout son argent dans un casino indien. Les indiens rachètent South Park pour construire une autoroute géante.

programme.title: South Park: est Gay!
programme.desc: La nouvelle folie 'métrosexuelle' (un show télévisé) envahit la ville de South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Rock chrétien
programme.desc: Suite à un pari avec Kyle, Cartman décide de monter un groupe de rock chrétien avec Token et Butters, dans le but d'obtenir un disque de platine.

programme.title: South Park: Rencontre du troisième âge
programme.desc: À South Park, comme dans tout le pays, les vieux au volant sont considérés comme un fléau. Une loi est votée pour leur confisquer leur permis de conduire. Mais le troisième âge contre-attaque.

programme.title: South Park: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: La mère de Kyle doit emmener ce dernier et ses amis à Casa Bonita, une version mexicaine de Disneyland au Colorado. Au lieu d'inviter Cartman, Kyle lui préfère Butters.

programme.title: South Park: Tout sur les Mormons
programme.desc: Un enfant mormon arrive dans la classe des garçons. Stan est supposé lui casser la figure, mais son père et lui sont soudain fascinés par la religion des nouveaux venus, et leur extrême gentillesse. Stan ne tardera pas à revenir sur son avis.

programme.title: South Park: Stop clopes
programme.desc: Les garçons sont surpris en train de fumer après avoir vu un spectacle ringard contre la cigarette. Rob Reiner, militant extrémiste anti-tabac, décide de piéger les fabricants de cigarettes avec l'aide des garçons.

programme.title: South Park: Raisins
programme.desc: Stan déprime quand Wendy le plaque. Ses amis l'emmènent alors au 'Raisins', réputé pour ses hôtesses de bar sexy. Butters tombe amoureux de l'une d'entre elles, et Stan décide de devenir gothique.

programme.title: South Park: Noël au Canada
programme.desc: Les parents biologiques d'Ike reviennent le chercher chez les parents de Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Les armes, c'est rigolo
programme.desc: Grâce à un stratagème surfait, les garçons obtiennent des armes ninja. Alors qu'ils jouent, ils blessent leur camarade Butters. Pris dans un dilemme draconien, les garçons décident de le déguiser en chien pour l'emmener chez le véterinaire.

programme.title: South Park: Génial-O
programme.desc: Cartman s'habille comme un robot, s'auto-proclame 'Génial-O' et déménage chez Butters pour découvrir tous ses secrets et les utiliser contre lui.

programme.title: South Park: Les stéroïdes ça déchire
programme.desc: Jimmy s'entraîne pour un événement sportif imminent et est déterminé à gagner à n'importe quel prix. Cartman décide qu'il peut facilement remporter la première place contre Jimmy.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats continue their journey to Yuba, where a bittersweet reunion with a childhood friend awaits Princess Vivi.
programme.sub-title: Rebel Warrior Koza! The Dream vowed to Vivi!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fire Fist Ace is hired by two young boys to hunt down and capture a lethal bounty hunter known only as the Scorpion.
programme.sub-title: Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper, Zoro, and Luffy get separated from the others. When the heat makes Luffy act even stranger than usual, his friends wonder if they joined the right pirate gang.
programme.sub-title: Ruins and Lost Ways! Vivi, Her Friends and the Country's Form!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The assassins of Baroque Works gather at Spider’s Café, and the Straw Hats arrive at Yuba only to find it buried in sand.
programme.sub-title: Spiders Caf? at 8 o'Clock! The Enemy Leaders Gather!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile reveals himself to the Baroque Works assassins and discloses his dastardly plan for Alabasta. After departing Yuba, Luffy takes a stand that forces Vivi to rethink her mission.
programme.sub-title: Luffy vs. Vivi! The Tearful Vow to Put Friends on the Line

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Vivi takes Luffy’s advice, and the Straw Hats head towards Rainbase for a confrontation with Crocodile. Karoo finally reaches the palace with Vivi’s warning for King Cobra.
programme.sub-title: The Battlefront of Alabasta! Rainbase, the City of Dreams

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy leads a daring – but foolish – raid on Crocodile’s casino. His poor planning lands him behind bars with Captain Smoker – and more importantly, leaves Vivi unprotected.
programme.sub-title: The Trap of Certain Defeat! Storming Raindinners!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While the Straw Hats are stuck in the clink, King Cobra addresses the starving people of Nanohana. Will his unbelievable revelation drive his subjects past the brink of rebellion?
programme.sub-title: Operation Utopia Commences! The Swell of Rebellion Stirs!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A royal imposter has the rebel army hell-bent on bringing Cobra’s reign to a violent end. Meanwhile, Luffy and his mates find themselves in deep trouble and even deeper water.
programme.sub-title: The Terrifying Banana Gators and Mr. Prince!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji shows up in the nick of time to make the crocs cough up the key to Luffy’s freedom, but the ravenous reptiles spit up something else instead.
programme.sub-title: The Key to a Great Comeback Escape! The Wax-Wax Ball!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile snatches Vivi off the back of a giant crab, but Luffy’s not having it. The rubber-man goes toe-to-toe with the sandman in a battle that will end in bloodshed.
programme.sub-title: Merciless Mortal Combat! Luffy vs Crocodile

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile puts Luffy down for a never-ending dirt nap, and the Straw Hats get a lift from a crabby ally in their race to stop the looming rebellion.
programme.sub-title: Dash For a Miracle! Alabasta Animal Land

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Vivi arrives in Alubarna with just enough time to stop the rebellion, but the agents of Baroque Works lurk in every corner, waiting to sabotage her plans for peace.
programme.sub-title: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji buys Vivi some time by mixing it up with a foe of many faces. Outside Alubarna’s walls, Chopper and Usopp tangle with Miss Merry Christmas and her slugging sidekick.
programme.sub-title: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp finally shows some courage by using a five-ton hammer to play whack-a-mole with Miss Merry Christmas. He may be bluffing, but the distraction lets Chopper zero in on the enemy’s weakness.
programme.sub-title: Sworn on a Friend's Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper’s Rumble Ball could be the difference between life and death in the mole ballgame. Elsewhere, Sanji has trouble kicking a pretty enemy, and Vivi proposes something unthinkable.
programme.sub-title: Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Vivi continues preparations to blow up the palace; Zorro puts his steel to the test against a lethal blade-man; Sanji tries to overcome his inability to kick a foxy lady!
programme.sub-title: Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay's Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Things don’t look good for the prettiest Straw Hat. Nami’s about to tangle with a thorny adversary, and the weapon Usopp built her is only good for party tricks!
programme.sub-title: Nami's Cyclone Advisory! Clima Tact Burst!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile reveals his sinister motives for attacking Alabasta, and Nami tries to end her duel with Miss Doublefinger by unleashing the Clima Tact’s ultimate weapon: a devastatingly lethal tornado!
programme.sub-title: Secret Passed Down In The Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro hopes to attain a new level of strength when he fights a foe with a body made of blades. The Straw Hat sword-slinger is determined to become a man who can cut steel – or die trying.
programme.sub-title: Secret Of Powerful Swordplay! Ability To Cut Steel And The Rhythm Things Have!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Koza – the leader of the rebel army – finally discovers the evil mastermind behind Alabasta’s drought, but is he too late to prevent further bloodshed?
programme.sub-title: The Battle is Over! Koza Raises the White Flag!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When Koza is mysteriously shot, the rebellion is reborn, but Vivi’s cries for a cease-fire fall on deaf ears until a long-overdue hero swoops to the rescue!
programme.sub-title: Where Vivi's Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy finally discovers the secret to knocking out a sandman, but it won’t matter unless Vivi and the rest of the Straw Hats can locate the Baroque Works bomber.
programme.sub-title: Sand Croc and Water Luffy!... The Second Round of the Duel!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While his mates search for a bomb, Luffy narrowly survives his second scrape with Crocodile. Across town, Nico Robin strong-arms Cobra into revealing his country’s greatest secret.
programme.sub-title: That Looks Croc-ish!... Luffy, Run to the Royal Tomb!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the walls crumbling down around them, Crocodile attacks Luffy with a poisoned pirate hook. Meanwhile, Vivi draws a bead on the bombers, but can she stop them in time?
programme.sub-title: The Nightmare Draws Near!... This is the Sand-Sand Clan's Secret Base

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats team up to give Vivi one last shot at disarming the bomb that threatens to destroy her city. She succeeds in cutting the fuse, but Crocodile has a backup plan.
programme.sub-title: Magnificent Wings! My Name is Pell, Guardian Deity of the Country

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Pell’s sacrifice spares his beloved city, but only an act of god can stop the rebellion. With Crocodile’s poison coursing through his body, Luffy musters a final attack against Alabasta’s oppressor.
programme.sub-title: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls in Alabasta.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Crocodile is defeated, the rain has returned to Alabasta, and Vivi’s people are eager to rebuild their kingdom. As for the Straw Hats, they have a fleet of marines breathing down their necks.
programme.sub-title: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and Different Ideas of Justice!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Now that the rebellion is over, Vivi must make an important decision about her future. The Straw Hats are ready to hoist the anchor, but an ambiguous villain has stolen the Going Merry!
programme.sub-title: The Pirates' Banquet And Operation Escape From Alabasta!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Mr. 2 is a man of many faces, but he finally shows his true colors when the marines attack the Straw Hats. Elsewhere, Vivi has a scheme up her sleeve, and it involves Igaram wearing a dress.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones

programme.title: Arthur

programme.desc: Arthur and Francine are fighting. But when they get locked inside the library they either have to make up or prepare for a long evening. And when Buster opens his detective agency, he has no idea his first job will involve Arthur.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur and his friends go to summer camp where it's strictly boys vs. girls. Next, Buster Baxter is everyone's favorite jokester. Unfortunately, though, Buster's grades aren't as good as his jokes, and Buster may have to repeat third grade.
programme.sub-title: Arthur Goes To Camp/Buster Makes The Grade

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur's new puppy is exactly what he wanted. He's cute and wriggly, and he follows Arthur everywhere. But training a puppy is harder than Arthur thought. Then, a mere $10 stands between Arthur and the shoes he's been dreaming about.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: You think running a marathon is hard? Try babysitting for the Terrible Tibble Twins. Next, Arthur's family is hosting the once-a-year-is-more-than-enough family reunion. But a major thunderstorm turns this into a reunion to remember.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Only four more days until Arthur's birthday party! But to Arthur's horror, it turns out Muffy's having her birthday party on the very same day. And, now that Francine finally has the lead in a school play, she's has become a stage tyrant.

programme.title: Arthur

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Struggling with a school assignment, Arthur decides that his regular life is just too boring to write about. And, Arthur is the only one who believes in the superior intelligence of his dog. But even Arthur gets confused when Pal runs away.

programme.desc: D.W.'s beloved bird gets very sick, and despite D.W.'s eager ministrations, Spanky dies. Can she risk giving her heart to another pet? Then, Buster doesn't have time for Arthur. And all he wants to talk about is a new friend named Mike.

programme.desc: Arthur always seems to wreck things, and this time it's Mom's computer. Can he get it fixed before Mom finds out? Then, Muffy A. Crosswire and Francine are absolute best friends, despite their rather obvious differences.

programme.desc: What's got moldy bathrooms, lumpy beds and lots of rain? Arthur's family vacation. Then, Arthur and D.W. go to visit their grandfather, but the visit doesn't turn out as expected, because Grandpa Dave isn't your usual kind of grandfather.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's a nightmare--Arthur and Buster have to work with Binky. On an art project! I mean, what does a bully like Binky know about art? Then, Arthur discovers the secret to success--a pencil that brings good luck to whoever possesses it.
programme.sub-title: Binky Barnes, Art Expert/Arthur's Lucky Pencil

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's wrong to call D.W. a picky eater. The only things she won't eat are vegetables, fish, fruit, and meat. Then, Arthur and Buster meet two really cool kids and, naturally, are utterly dazzled. How far will Buster go to be cool?
programme.sub-title: D.W., The Picky Eater/Buster And The Daredevils

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Too young to see a real "James Hound" movie, the kids decide they'll make a film of their own. Next, how would YOU like to be four years old and completely misunderstood by your parents? And then be sent to your room for ten whole minutes?
programme.sub-title: Arthur Makes A Movie/Go To Your Room!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur thinks it's hilarious when Binky Barnes' pants split during class--until he starts having nightmares about it happening to him. Then, Francine secretly dreams of being an Olympic equestrienne, but first she has to learn to ride.

programme.title: Captain Fantastic
programme.desc: Raised in the forest and living off the grid, six children venture into the outside world for the first time when their recently widowed father takes them on a road trip.

programme.title: Being Flynn

programme.title: A Family Man

programme.title: Cold Mountain

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: As a woman (Jessica Chastain) tries to reintroduce her lover's (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) traumatized nieces to a normal life, disturbing questions and occurrences suggest that a supernatural presence has followed the girls to her home.

programme.title: The Messengers
programme.desc: A teen (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother desperately try to warn their disbelieving family about ominous apparitions that only the children see.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Autumn says she was called a “crazy, jealous girlfriend” after video of her keying her ex-boyfriend’s car went viral. She says ex-boyfriend, D’Andre, choked her, head-butted her and sexually assaulted her; D’Andre denies sexually assaulting her. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Arrested For Keying Ex-Boyfriend's Car Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say the green-eyed monster has affected their marriage. Paula claims loyalty and Mike questions her fidelity. Mike placed listening devices in the home, set up surveillance cameras to follow her, and subjected Paula to polygraph tests.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: At 700 lbs., Pauline, 48, has a Guinness World Record title of Heaviest Living Woman. Pauline is also a mother, daughter & friend with hopes and dreams of a better life for herself & her 18-year-old son Dillon. Can Dr. Phil help get her life on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 21 years, Paula is considering divorcing husband, Jeremy, saying he's "clueless, absent & non-verbal." Jeremy says it's Paula--controlling & a grudge-holder. Find out Jeremy's mistake. Dr. Phil and Robin share the secret to their 45-year marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates a popular new website that dishes the dirt on non-celebrities. On creator Nik Richie's controversial site, TheDirty.com, people anonymously submit photos & negative comments about anyone in their community, tabloid style.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil discusses teen pregnancy: In the U.S., one in six become teen moms with fathers often not held to the same accountability in child-rearing. Taten, 18, has an infant daughter with one teen girl, with another teen pregnant. Paternity test results.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keith says his wife of 18 years, Sarah, is divorcing him and leaving their four children for "Kevin," a 26-year-old Kenyan pastor she met only on the internet. Dr. Phil sent a team to Kenya to investigate. You won’t want to miss what they discover!
programme.sub-title: My Wife Of 18 Years And Mother Of Our 4 Children Is Divorcing Me For A 26-Year-Old Kenyan Man She's Never Met

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mom Anita & daughter Alexa say an incident 3 years ago left the family shattered: an ex-husband, a loaded gun, a little boy caught between parents & now an ex-mother-in-law who says her son is blameless & is going to court for grandson visitation rights.
programme.sub-title: My Grandson's Father Nearly Killed Us And His Mother Is Battling Us In Court

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shelby wants to find the truth about her dad's online relationship with a woman he's never met. Dad David says "Maria" has a $10 million inheritance and says he knows for a fact that "Maria" is a real person and he can't wait to introduce her one day.
programme.sub-title: My Dad Believes He's Married To A Woman Named "Maria" He's Never Met Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explored the topic of infidelity on a recent show sparking debates and thousands of viewer responses. Dr. Phil addresses a flood of comments on his social media and answers the question: "Is it possible to make your marriage affair-proof?" Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Quinn says his wife, Sara, smashed a glass door, putting several stitches in his head, and punched, slapped, and kicked him in the face. But why won't he leave her? Can Dr. Phil help mend this fractured family as he confronts Sara about the alleged abuse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 2011, Morgan, 20, was found dead, a suspected overdose with a later ruling of death by suicide. Parents Toni & Steve believe something more sinister: she was stalked, tormented & killed by Brooke, 18, who joins the show with her dad, Jim.
programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil Mystery: Was Morgan Murdered By Stalkers?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Family squabbles are hard to avoid -- especially during the holidays -- but what happens when that behavior escalates to cursing, yelling, and even physical attacks? Dr. Phil sits down with a family on the brink of falling apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dana says daughter Melanie, 23, is a drug abuser whose behavior is ripping apart their peaceful family. Melanie admits to experimenting with drugs but says she's not addicted & she blames her mom for pushing her buttons and causing her to lose her cool.
programme.sub-title: A Daughter On The Brink: Did Mom Push Her Over The Edge?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A recent study shows that the number of men and women having extramarital affairs is on the rise. Could your spouse be cheating on you? Dr. Phil's guests are struggling with the aftermath of infidelity.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many were stunned and outraged when Casey Anthony was acquitted of murder charges in her daughter Caylee's death. Lead prosecutor Jeff Ashton joins Dr. Phil to answer some hard-hitting questions about where his case went wrong.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you ignoring warning signs in your relationship? Is there something concerning you that you haven't addressed? Dr. Phil warns his viewers: Don't think your problems will go away once you walk down the aisle, face the issues now before it's too late!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Thirty-year-old mom of four, Melissa Dilan-Hernandez, made headlines when arrested and charged with having sex with her 17-year-old fiancé, T.J. The couple sits down with Dr. Phil to justify their relationship. Plus, does T.J.'s father approve?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when a household is in total meltdown and filled with constant battles? Meet a mother who is afraid of her 17-year-old son and the stepfather who says he's caught in the middle. But is the boy the only one to blame for the chaos in the house?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This 2004 YouTube viral video sent shock waves, racked up millions of views, and stirred online outrage. Texas Judge William Adams is lashing his then 16-year-old daughter with a belt, despite her pleas to stop. Do you think Adam's actions are justified?
programme.sub-title: Discipline Video: A Daughter's New Accusations Against The Judge

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Monster-In-Law is back! Khalood confessed to calling her son-in-law, Steve, a "loser" and "dumbass" and lacing his drink with a laxative! Does she still say Steve is incapable of supporting a family? Hear what Steve’s mom has to say about the feud!

programme.title: Love Island

programme.title: Love Island
